description.value: You come from a line of wandering mercenaries constantly on the march and scavenging food on the trail. If you fail, but don't critically fail, to @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Subsist] in the wilderness, you can still keep yourself fed with poor meals. When exploring, you can @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Hustle] twice as long before you have to stop.
